description: Figure 19 illustrates the average probing accuracy using different Multilingual BERT (mBERT) and XLM-RoBERTa (XLMR) variations, with the size(s) of hidden layers indicated in square brackets. The horizontal axis represents the probing variations, labeled as “hidden-(50), linear”, “hidden-(100), linear”, and “hidden-(50, 50), ReLU”, and “hidden-(100), ReLU”, with categories arranged linearly. The vertical axis represents the probing accuracy, labeled as “% point difference”, with a linear scale ranging from approximately -0.2 to 0.2, and tick marks at 0.0, -0.1, 0.1, and 0.2. Four bars are displayed, each representing a probing variation. The bar for “hidden-(50), linear” is blue and extends to approximately 0.02. The bar for “hidden-(100), linear” is blue and extends to approximately 0.04. The bar for “hidden-(50, 50), ReLU” is red and extends to approximately 0.12. The bar for “hidden-(100), ReLU” is red and extends to approximately 0.18. The bars are not sorted in any apparent order, and no bars are visually emphasized.
